sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-front man with dark side-parted hair, dark brows and full dark moustache/beard. White peaked naval cap, dark band, ornate gold central crest and gold visor embroidery. Dark navy coat with small gold collar devices and shoulder boards, grey shirt and black tie, solemn closed mouth mostly within beard. Full pale grey-beige painted backing; preserve cap, beard, close bust and short broad neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-front man slightly toward screen right with short dark side-parted hair, strong brows and neat black moustache, clean chin. Mild tooth-showing smile. Dark blue naval coat with small gold stars and shoulder clusters, white pointed shirt and navy tie. Full pale grey-beige backing, soft directional light, close bust; preserve moustache only, visible teeth and broad short fitted neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Older man in slight screen-right three-quarter view with swept silver hair/brows, long white handlebar moustache and full white-grey beard. White peaked naval cap with dark band, ornate gold crest and gold visor embroidery. Dark navy uniform with red/gold collar devices and shoulder trim, grey shirt and dark tie; stern mouth. Full pale grey-beige painted backing, close bust and compact broad neck under beard.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Smiling woman in slight screen-left view with short brown rolled curls under a broad rust-brown brimmed hat. Round pale-rimmed glasses with dark shaded lenses, brown brows and visible smiling teeth. Rust-orange lapelled coat over an olive-green scarf with yellow spots, tied at neck with tails sweeping screen right. Full dark grey-brown painted backing and soft shaded light; preserve hat, glasses, scarf and short broad neckline.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-front smiling woman with brown hair swept high into rolled forehead waves and curled shoulder-length ends, brown brows and tooth-showing smile. Muted purple draped high-neck top fastened with a rectangular gold-framed clasp and small gold studs across shoulders/chest. No visible glasses, hat or jewellery. Full dark grey-brown painted backing and close bust; preserve folds, smile and short broad neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-front smiling woman with short densely curled brown hair, brown brows and visible smiling teeth. Mustard-gold collared blouse with open pointed neckline, large linked gold necklace carrying several yellow-green oval stones. No glasses, hat or beard. Full dark grey-brown painted backing, close bust and soft light; preserve necklace arrangement, open collar and compact broad mascot neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-front smiling woman with dark brown rolled forehead wave beneath a cream headscarf with olive-gold patterned border, wrapped around sides and tied beneath chin. Dark brown high-lapelled coat over a small dark red inner section; brown brows and tooth-showing smile. Full dark grey-brown painted backing and soft directional light. Preserve tied scarf, raised collar and short broad neck without adding jewellery or eyewear.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-front smiling woman with brown side-parted hair loosely gathered behind head, brown brows and tooth-showing smile. Grey pointed-collar buttoned blouse with dark and gold buttons. Her raised hand at screen left holds a long dark smoking holder with pale tip and curling grey smoke; retain exact hand/finger pose and object. Full dark grey-brown painted backing, close bust and soft light; short broad neck and grey fitted collar.
